consequence_for_the_manuscript: degree 5 and height 4, so the claim that every exactly-known planar threshold has degree <= 6 and height <= 3 is false. The true historical range, on what we can verify, is degree <= 6 and height <= 4, and results/pslq-degree6-height4-* censuses that class

cross_check_against_the_quoted_decimal.why_this_matters: the polynomial and the decimal were taken from independent summaries; a transcription error in either would almost certainly break this agreement
